name: lftp
description: lftp is a sophisticated file-transfer client supporting FTP, FTPS, SFTP, HTTP/HTTPS, HFTP, FISH and BitTorrent. It mirrors whole directory trees both ways, downloads in parallel segments, resumes transfers, queues jobs in the background, and is fully scriptable via -e/-c/-f commands.

install_steps: sudo apt-get install -y lftp || sudo dnf install -y lftp || brew install lftp

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install lftp: apt install lftp (or brew install lftp)

commands.description: Open an interactive lftp session to a server (ftp://, sftp://, http://...)
